executive_summary.strengths: Distinguishes reclosable closures and initial heat seals, lists six closure styles and five sealing approaches, offers product-choice table and seal troubleshooting FAQ.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Universal laminate composition and oxygen-barrier assertions are inaccurate as generalizations; heat/zipper seals are presented as completely leakproof/oxygen-blocking; misuse of vacuum/oxygen absorber concepts and insufficient regulated-product nuance.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Differentiate metallized PET vs foil laminate and film sealant structures; qualify barrier performance and leak resistance; provide validation/testing variables, machine settings as manufacturer-specific, and regulated-use disclaimers.
